pass: Fights or orders the attack, and refuses her outright. Mocking contempt for her (her youth, her lot, her weakness). No fear, no bargaining, no retreat.

earlier: Velas is the chief of the elves. He is not here in his true body: this is one of his machine bodies, which he controls from far away. He has many.
Nyra the Demon Lord has brought her army to destroy the elf village. They have hated each other for ages.

dialogue.spoken: So the old man came out himself. Or is that another of your dolls? Hand over the children you've gathered and I'll only burn half your forest.
